name: Asa Newell
comment: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

name: Keshon Gilbert
comment: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Mikel Brown Jr.
comment: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Grant Nelson
comment: Nelson signed a two-way contract with the Nets on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Egor Demin
comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

name: Brandon Miller
comment: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Monday's game against Cleveland.

name: Moussa Diabate
comment: Diabate (quadriceps) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against Cleveland.

name: Grant Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Dennis Schroder
comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Norman Powell
comment: Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Zach Collins
comment: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

name: Sam Merrill
comment: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Hornets.

name: Jaylon Tyson
comment: Tyson (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Hornets.

name: Morez Johnson Jr.
comment: Johnson (leg) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers.

name: Sergio de Larrea
comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Isaiah Joe
comment: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

name: Gary Payton II
comment: Payton (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Brandon Williams
comment: Williams has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against the Pelicans due to a left hamstring injury, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports. He'll finish with four points (2-3 FG) in two minutes.

name: Will Richard
comment: Richard is deciding between getting surgery or playing with a splint, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Oscar Tshiebwe
comment: Tshiebwe has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to an illness.

name: Clint Capela
comment: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram (Achilles) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Cam Christie
comment: Christie is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Suns due to a right ankle sprain, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Austin Reaves
comment: Reaves (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Atlanta, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

name: Quentin Grimes
comment: Grimes (finger) is out for Monday's game against Atlanta, per Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com.

name: Isaiah Stewart
comment: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Toronto.

name: Quinten Post
comment: Post (head) didn't return to Monday's 118-102 win over the Raptors. He ended the night with one rebound in two minutes.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (back) won't play in Monday's game versus the Raptors.

name: Richie Saunders
comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
comment: Antetokounmpo is probable for Tuesday's game against the Jazz due to a right wrist sprain.

name: Kel'el Ware
comment: Ware is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks due to a left ankle sprain.

name: Tyler Herro
comment: Herro (contusion) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.

name: Anthony Edwards
comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Trendon Watford
comment: Watford (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

name: Trey Murphy III
comment: Murphy (knee) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

name: Yves Missi
comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

name: Josh Hart
comment: Hart is doubtful for Tuesday's game against the Bucks due to an illness.

name: Jaylin Williams
comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

name: Cason Wallace
comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams
comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Tristan da Silva
comment: Da Silva is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Kings due to a left calf strain.

name: Jalen Suggs
comment: Suggs (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

name: Paolo Banchero
comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Adem Bona
comment: Bona (back) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.

name: Dominick Barlow
comment: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

name: Vit Krejci
comment: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Devin Vassell
comment: Vassell (groin) is out for Monday's game against the Suns, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Monday's game against Phoenix.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
comment: Leonard (knee) is continuing the reconditioning process, and another update will be provided in one week, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: Immanuel Quickley
comment: Quickley (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

name: Collin Murray-Boyles
comment: Murray-Boyles (illness) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

name: Scottie Barnes
comment: Barnes (groin) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

name: Lauri Markkanen
comment: Markkanen is out for Tuesday's game versus the Heat with a right wrist sprain.

name: Keyonte George
comment: George (ankle) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Heat.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Bilal Coulibaly
comment: Coulibaly (hand) is out for Monday's game against the Pistons.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

name: Reece Beekman
comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

name: Justin Champagnie
comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
